انطلبت (form VII)
# اِنْطَلَبْتُ (inṭalabtu) /in.tˤa.lab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْطَلَبَ (inṭalaba)
# اِنْطَلَبْتَ (inṭalabta) /in.tˤa.lab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْطَلَبَ (inṭalaba)
# اِنْطَلَبْتِ (inṭalabti) /in.tˤa.lab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْطَلَبَ (inṭalaba)
# اِنْطَلَبَتْ (inṭalabat) /in.tˤa.la.bat/: third-pe
